scripts.build: pnpm --filter './packages/*' build && pnpm --filter './apps/*' build && pnpm --filter @pmndrs/glyph-benchmarks build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter './packages/*' --if-present test && pnpm --filter './apps/*' --if-present test && pnpm --filter @pmndrs/glyph-benchmarks test --runtime-packages-ready
scripts.check: tsc -p .claude/tsconfig.json && node --test .claude/hooks/sync-agent-config.test.ts && pnpm --filter './packages/*' check && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter './apps/*' check && pnpm --filter @pmndrs/glyph-benchmarks check --runtime-packages-ready && oxfmt --check .claude/hooks .claude/settings.json .claude/tsconfig.json package.json .agents/docs/log.md && ruby .agents/skills/open-knowledge-format/scripts/validate_okf.rb .agents/docs --workspace-root .
